subtitle: One-off SQL assertions the generic tests can't express

steps.label: A select statement
steps.sub: Returns the rows that violate the assertion

steps.label: Zero rows = pass
steps.sub: Name comes straight from the filename

eyebrow: A real singular test (dbt Labs' own example)
code:
-- tests/assert_total_payment_amount_is_positive.sql
-- Refunds are negative; total should always be >= 0
select
    order_id,
    sum(amount) as total_amount
from {{ ref('fct_payments') }}
group by 1
having total_amount < 0
caption: Any row returned = a real order_id to debug with, in hand.

code:
# tests/schema.yml
data_tests:
  - name: assert_total_payment_amount_is_positive
    description: >
      Refunds have a negative amount, so the total
      amount should always be >= 0.
caption: Not declared in a model's schema.yml — it gets its own entry.
